shortDescription: The Milwaukee Brewers option in Polymarket's "Texas Rangers vs. Milwaukee Brewers" submarket "Spread -1.5" surged from 50.5% an hour ago to 90%, a 39.5 percentage-point move. According to ChainCatcher, the sharp swing may reflect the impact of a sudden news event.
